hints.title: Dual Hash Map Invariance
hints.text: Maintain two maps: one mapping number to its current frequency, and another mapping frequency to count of numbers having that frequency.

hints.title: Constant Time Frequency Queries
hints.text: hasFrequency queries can be answered in O(1) by checking whether the frequency-count map has a positive value.

hints.title: Safe Deletion Transitions
hints.text: When deleting an occurrence of a number, only decrement if the number exists and has frequency strictly greater than zero.

hints.title: Two-Map Frequency Tracker Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) for add, deleteOne, and hasFrequency
complexity.notes: Bi-directional frequency mapping allows O(1) updates and queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning frequencies linearly takes O(N) per query causing TLE across 10^5 calls.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for dual mapping tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains dual count mappings to guarantee O(1) query response time.
